review.gallery: Nine verified renders from Ellington’s named Cala Del Mar page, including the full waterfront elevation used on listing cards.
review.location: Developer View Island map and JRE site point identify the same waterfront position. Eleven drive times read from the official map. The main page separately lists 5 and 34 minutes to the same RAK airport; the map confirms 34. Wynn’s future opening confirmed in the 5 November 2026 results: https://investors.wynnresorts.com/news-releases/news-release-details/wynn-resorts-limited-reports-third-quarter-2026-results.
review.floorPlans: Nine complete drawings from two official PDFs. The brochure’s embedded text layer differs from its visibly printed figures for 1 BR Types A and B. The visible brochure tables, standalone plan PDF and launch brief agree on 691.69 and 808.05 sq ft, so those printed figures are used. Duplicate broker floor-plan PDF was byte-identical to the official file. The 13th-floor penthouse is listed but no public layout sheet was verified.

unavailable: Four-bedroom penthouse layout, individual contracted plans and verified visitor entrance.
